ranking_requirements: Solve the 132 Vrms model current to deliver 1796.310032 W input including ripple: P/V=13.6084093 A is only an ideal-PF lower bound, not the true-RMS setpoint. Retain 108 Vrms at the 15 A derating limit.

Measure 0/+15 V gate waveform at Kelvin source, including plateau, overshoot and ringing; log any peak above a provisional 16 V review flag, then check the actual operating and absolute limits from the data sheet. The 16 V flag is not a qualification limit.
Double-pulse at 400 V over instantaneous switching-current range, then CCM PFC at 108/120/132 Vrms; hold fixture states at 25/100/125 C and fit EON/EOFF only to matched conditions.
Prove AUX_15V regulation at driver pins through startup, shutdown, UVLO and faults; EN must be fail-off and the unused driver channel disabled.
Close bridge, diode, magnetic, shunt, capacitor, auxiliary, cooling and EMI terms before any whole-assembly ranking.

escalation_trigger.interleaved: Escalate only after the single-boost coupon is measured and the system loss/thermal budget or inductor-current/EMI limits are demonstrably missed; then evaluate a two-phase interleaved bridge-boost. Expect a second MOSFET/diode/inductor/current path and a second driver channel; do not claim the benefit before a matched assembly measurement.
escalation_trigger.bridgeless: Evaluate only if measured bridge diode conduction and commutation loss is the dominant remaining shortfall and line-commutation/EMI controls are available. Removing the bridge adds line-referenced switching and control/EMI complexity; it is not a free loss subtraction.
escalation_trigger.status: trigger criteria only; no interleaved or bridgeless design performed
